hubNote: 🔒 = Premium. Everything stays on your phone.
err: Couldn't connect. Try again in a moment.
wNeed2: Save your weight on two different days to see the chart.
wNote: Weight goes up and down day to day. We look at the trend, not one day.
aNeed: Save your weight a few times over at least 5 days and Angie will adjust your goal.
aOk: You're on track. Your goal stays the same.
aSlow: Your weight is steady. A small change can help.
aFast: You're losing quickly. Let's eat a bit more to take care of you.
aGain: To gain, you can eat a bit more.
aGainFast: You're gaining quickly. Let's slow down a little.
aKeep: Let's adjust a little to keep your weight.
aLocked: The adaptive coach adjusts your goal with your real weight trend.
memWhat: Angie remembers what you tell her (for example "I don't eat fish") to help you better.
memPrivacy: Saved only on this phone. You can delete it anytime.
impHow: In MyFitnessPal: Settings → Export data. You'll get a CSV file (Nutrition). Choose it here.
impPaste: Or paste the text of the file:
impBad: I couldn't read that file. Use the MyFitnessPal "Nutrition" CSV.
vPh: Example: I had 2 arepas with cheese
vNoMic: Voice is not available in this browser. Write it instead.
tBalD: Arepas, rice, beans, chicken and fruit, in the right portions.
tProtD: 5 meals with more protein to build muscle.
tVegD: No meat or fish: beans, eggs, cheese and vegetables.
plLocked: Diet plans made for your goal.
chHow: Take a photo of your fridge, pantry or spices and Angie suggests 3 recipes.
chNone: I couldn't find food. Try another photo.
chLocked: Recipes with what you have at home.
mnLeft: You have about {{kcal}} kcal left today.
mnPh: Or paste the dishes of the menu
mnNone: I couldn't read the menu. Try another photo.
mnLocked: Take a photo of the menu and Angie tells you what fits best.
crHow: What are you craving? Choose one and Angie gives you a tasty, lighter option.
crSave: From {{a}} to {{b}} kcal: you save {{d}} kcal.
crKind: And if you want the original, enjoy it calmly. No guilt.

pizza.s: Tortilla pizza with chicken and vegetables

chocolate.s: 2 squares of dark chocolate with strawberries

soda.s: Sparkling water with lime and mint

slHours: How many hours did you sleep?
slTipStress: Breathe slowly for one minute. A short walk also helps.
slTipShort: Short night. Drink water and try to go to bed a bit earlier today.
slTipGood: Good rest helps you control appetite. Keep it up!
slBreathSay: Breathe in for four seconds. Hold for four. Breathe out slowly for six. Again.
remHow: Angie shows friendly reminders on the home screen. Choose which ones.
remNote: Phone notifications will come with the app.

r.water: Time for a glass of water 💧
r.meal: Log your first meal of the day 📸
r.move: Today is a workout day. Just 20 minutes 💪
r.sleep: How did you sleep? Tap to log it 😴

ptRules: Meal 5 · glass of water 1 · daily challenge 10 · workout 20 · weight 5 · sleep 3
wkLogged: You logged food on {{n}} of 7 days.
wkKcal: You ate {{a}} kcal on average; your goal is {{b}}.
wkCheer2: Every day counts. This week we start again together.
wkLocked: Every week Angie tells you your progress out loud.
avSayGood: Great job today! I'm with you.
avSayStart: Hi! Let's start the day with a glass of water.
avNote: This is your first clone. The full 3D twin comes in Premium Plus.
avLocked: Customize your avatar and unlock rewards.

rpe.easy: Next time it will be a bit harder.
rpe.hard: Next time it will be a bit easier.

fbNote: Saved on this phone for now, without your name.
devSub: Reads opinions and metrics and proposes changes. You approve with one tap. It never publishes by itself.
devQueued: Approved: goes to a test branch. Publishing needs your OK.
devNever: Never touches payments or money and never publishes without you.
